scope.method: One model process at a time. Five repeated inferences on the same image. Candidate and incumbent used InsightFace 2.1, CPUExecutionProvider, unquantized publisher ONNX weights.
scope.memory_sampler: macOS ps RSS sampled every 0.2 seconds; the wrapper terminated the exact child PID if it exceeded its declared RAM cap.
scope.quality_limit: No identity-quality conclusion: blind independent agent labels and the disagreement adjudication are pending. This single crop is not representative of lighting, angle, occlusion, cross-camera, false-match, face-absent or contradictory-evidence cases.
